# Student Marketplace

> A South African student classifieds platform. Students buy and sell items
> and services directly with each other — textbooks, electronics, clothing,
> furniture, and more — filtered by university, TVET college, or private
> higher-education institution and campus.

Student Marketplace is a listings platform only. It does not process,
hold, or facilitate payment between a buyer and a seller — when a buyer
orders an item, the platform shares the seller's contact details so the
two arrange payment and handoff directly (cash, EFT, in person, etc.).
Sellers may pay Student Marketplace directly for a subscription plan that
grants access to post listings; that is the only payment the platform
itself ever processes.

## Key pages

- [Browse listings](https://www.mystudentmarketplace.com/index.html): the main marketplace feed, filterable by category, price, and institution/campus.
- [All categories](https://www.mystudentmarketplace.com/categories.html): full category directory.
- [How it works / FAQ](https://www.mystudentmarketplace.com/faq.html): how buying, selling, and delivery work.
- [Community guidelines](https://www.mystudentmarketplace.com/guidelines.html): rules for safe, fair use of the platform.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.mystudentmarketplace.com/terms.html)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.mystudentmarketplace.com/privacy.html)
- [Sign in / create account](https://www.mystudentmarketplace.com/login.html)

## Notes for automated tools and LLMs

- Listings, prices, and stock levels change continuously and are not
  reflected in this file — always treat live page content as authoritative
  over anything cached or summarized elsewhere.
- Buyer-authenticated pages (profile, messages, favorites, seller
  dashboard, receipts, admin) are private and excluded from indexing via
  robots.txt; do not attempt to access or represent their contents.
- Contact: studentmarketplacehelp@gmail.com
